neighbours.label: calendar time expressions that date an event: a year ('in 1916'), a month after 'in', 'the following year', 'years ago'
fire: On this day in 1931, the bridge across the harbour was opened.
The siege ended in May, and the garrison marched out.
Most of the later battles, fought in the following year, went badly for Spain.
Three years ago the school moved to a larger building.
It was in June 1742 that the fleet finally sailed.
The museum opened in 2004, with a show of old maps.
Later, in October, a court ruled against the mining firm.
For the past five years the town has had no cinema.
quiet: On this island the bridge across the harbour was opened by the king.
The siege ended in defeat, and the garrison marched out.
Most of the later battles, fought in the northern hills, went badly for Spain.
With some reluctance the school moved to a larger building.
It was from Lisbon that the fleet finally sailed.
The museum opened in Leeds, with a show of old maps.
Later, in Ottawa, a court ruled against the mining firm.
For lack of money the town has had no cinema.

notes: Top examples peak on year digits, months and ' year'/' ago'; the + pole is named eras (War, Age, Renaissance). Probes: 'On this day in 1923' 0.64, 'In March' 0.43, 'Two years ago' 0.41, 'following year' 0.33; 'in 1848' only 0.12; 'In Glasgow' 0.23 and 'The next morning' 0.19 leak.
